title: Responsible and Representative Multimodal Data Acquisition and Analysis: On Auditability, Benchmarking, Confidence, Data-Reliance & Explainability
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a conceptual framework (ABCDE) for responsible and representative multimodal data acquisition.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
